Note: The above JSON test cases assume the existence of a GUI and a controller with the specified functionalities. The "expected" outcomes are based on the requirements provided, and the actual implementation details may vary. The "expected" outcomes should be concrete and checkable, as per the oracle assertiveness criterion. The "preconditions" and "inputs" are derived from the context provided, and the "steps" are logical actions to perform in the test. The "kind" indicates whether the test is a positive test (expected to pass under normal conditions), a negative test (expected to fail under certain conditions), or a boundary test (testing at the edges of operational limits). The test suite covers all the requirements listed, with each requirement traced by at least one test case, and includes negative and boundary value testing. The test cases are grounded in the requirement text, and no specific values not provided in the requirements have been invented.
